summary: Require approval-bound pickup availability, persist recoverable pickup state, resolve cancellation identifiers locally, block unresolved equivalent mutations, and bind OAuth tokens to the selected FedEx environment.
reason: Pickup creation and cancellation are billable or state-changing operations whose identifiers must survive API gaps and whose production credentials must never be sent to sandbox endpoints or vice versa.
validated_outcome: Tests bind preflight account/carrier/date/time/address to the exact pickup, require a documented override otherwise, persist executing/scheduled/cancelled/outcome-unknown state, block unsafe equivalent requests with OS-backed execution leases, require separately confirmed reconciliation before retry, update the operational ledger before releasing approval state, reject HTTP redirect replay, resolve local identifiers, require a reason for legacy records, and reject access tokens from a different API origin.
